_comment: Canonical Cowork scheduled-job wrapper contract. Substitution tokens use {{$varname}} (engagement/cadence level) + {{shared.<key>}} (shared boilerplate). See Docs/plans/2026-06-05-v0.92.x-scheduled-jobs-sync-design.md §4 for schema; compose-scheduled-job-wrappers-helper.js for substitution semantics + validator modes.

substitution_tokens.$mcp_dispatch_lines: Computed kind-by-kind from prefs.mcps; FULLY DYNAMIC — no brand strings
substitution_tokens.$voice_notes_excerpt: Optional engagement-specific voice notes excerpt (<=200 chars) from prefs.personality.notes

shared_clauses.subskill_read_boilerplate: When the orchestrator instructs you to use ANY sub-skill (cowork:write-run-note-*, cowork:gather-*, etc.), READ that sub-skill's SKILL.md from .claude/skills/cowork/skills/<name>/ IN FULL and strictly follow ALL sections including any ## Pre-write self-check checklist. Return failed:contract-violation:<field> on any miss.
shared_clauses.connectivity_authority_clause: trust user-preferences.mcps served_by + connected as runtime authority; vault-config.mcp_map is bootstrap-time audit hint only. Load deferred MCP tools via ToolSearch BEFORE dispatch. Cross-reference resolved served_by names against reachable_namespaces[] before dispatching. NEVER emit "MCP unavailable" callouts when prefs + reachable show the served_by is connected.

preamble_template:
For each of the scheduled tasks below (one per cowork cadence), open the matching task in claude.ai's Cowork UI, replace the prompt body with the fenced block from the matching section, and save. Do not change the schedule.

After all sections are pasted, run `/cowork morning-briefing {{$engagement_id}}` in Claude Code as a smoke test.

This file was generated against sauce {{$sauce_version}} + cowork {{$cowork_version}} + contract {{$contract_version}}. When the sauce version moves past {{$sauce_version}}, re-run `/cowork sync-scheduled-jobs {{$engagement_id}}` to refresh.

morning-briefing.cadence_tone_hint: Forward-looking; tee up the day's focus with calendar + email + chat + project surfaces.

midday-tripwire.cadence_tone_hint: Short + punchy by design; only fires when tripwire_aspects trip — otherwise produces a brief 'all clear' note.

eod-review.cadence_tone_hint: Retrospective; what shipped, what's carrying forward, what tomorrow looks like. Memory tick at the bottom is mandatory.

weekly-review.cadence_tone_hint: Reflective; patterns across the week, what got dropped, what's queued for next week. Memory tick at the bottom is mandatory.

monthly-review.cadence_tone_hint: Longest-arc view; month's wins/misses, projects landed, what's on the next-month board.

lens_shift.cadence_tone_hint: Cold-perspective companion to warm MB; memory-skip + semantic-skip surfaces what yesterday's frame was hiding.
lens_shift.description: Weekly cold-perspective morning briefing — memory-skip for empirical anti-echo

reconcile-cowork.cadence_tone_hint: Silent on green; emits warning callouts only when anomalies detected.
